mapper.select: SELECT source_event_id sourceEventId,content_sha256 contentSha256,status FROM rpt_source_event_inbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND source_event_id=#{sourceEventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE rpt_source_event_inbox SET status='APPLIED',applied_at=#{at} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND source_event_id=#{sourceEventId} AND status='RECEIVED'
mapper.select: SELECT source_owner sourceOwner,partition_key partitionKey,contiguous_sequence contiguousSequence, maximum_seen_sequence maximumSeenSequence,projection_status status,version FROM rpt_projection_checkpoint WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND source_owner=#{sourceOwner} AND partition_key=#{partitionKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT active_projection_version FROM rpt_projection_registry WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND metric_family=#{family}
mapper.update: UPDATE rpt_projection_registry SET active_projection_version=#{projectionVersion},version=version+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND metric_family=#{family}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rpt_sales_daily(tenant_id,projection_version,business_date,org_id,store_id,terminal_id,cashier_id, currency,order_count,cancelled_order_count,return_count,gross_minor,discount_minor,surcharge_minor, receivable_minor,refund_minor,cash_received_minor,cash_refunded_minor,shift_difference_minor, promotion_snapshot_count,projection_status) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{targetProjectionVersion},#{event.businessDate},#{event.orgId},#{event.storeId}, #{event.terminalId},#{event.cashierId},#{event.currency},#{event.sales.orderCount}, #{event.sales.cancelledOrderCount},#{event.sales.returnCount},#{event.sales.grossMinor}, #{event.sales.discountMinor},#{event.sales.surchargeMinor},#{event.sales.receivableMinor}, #{event.sales.refundMinor},#{event.sales.cashReceivedMinor},#{event.sales.cashRefundedMinor}, #{event.sales.shiftDifferenceMinor},#{event.sales.promotionSnapshotCount},#{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_count=order_count+VALUES(order_count), cancelled_order_count=cancelled_order_count+VALUES(cancelled_order_count), return_count=return_count+VALUES(return_count),gross_minor=gross_minor+VALUES(gross_minor), discount_minor=discount_minor+VALUES(discount_minor),surcharge_minor=surcharge_minor+VALUES(surcharge_minor), receivable_minor=receivable_minor+VALUES(receivable_minor),refund_minor=refund_minor+VALUES(refund_minor), cash_received_minor=cash_received_minor+VALUES(cash_received_minor), cash_refunded_minor=cash_refunded_minor+VALUES(cash_refunded_minor), shift_difference_minor=shift_difference_minor+VALUES(shift_difference_minor), promotion_snapshot_count=promotion_snapshot_count+VALUES(promotion_snapshot_count), updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

INSERT INTO rpt_projection_lineage(tenant_id,source_event_id,source_content_sha256,source_schema_version, source_owner,source_partition_key,source_sequence,projection_version,metric_family,dimension_sha256, org_id,store_id,business_date,checkpoint_contiguous,checkpoint_maximum_seen,projection_status,processed_at) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{event.sourceEventId},#{event.contentSha256},#{event.schemaVersion},#{event.sourceOwner}, #{event.partitionKey},#{event.sourceSequence},#{targetProjectionVersion},#{event.metricFamily}, #{dimensionSha256},#{event.orgId},#{event.storeId},#{event.businessDate}, #{checkpoint.contiguousSequence},#{checkpoint.maximumSeenSequence},#{checkpoint.status},#{processedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checkpoint_contiguous=VALUES(checkpoint_contiguous), checkpoint_maximum_seen=VALUES(checkpoint_maximum_seen),projection_status=VALUES(projection_status), processed_at=VALUES(processed_at)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rpt_projection_checkpoint WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND projection_status='INCOMPLETE' AND ((#{family}='SALES' AND source_owner IN ('ORDER','SHIFT','PROMOTION')) OR (#{family}='INVENTORY_COST' AND source_owner IN ('INVENTORY','COSTING'))))
mapper.update: UPDATE rpt_sales_daily SET projection_status=#{status},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND projection_version=#{targetProjectionVersion}
UPDATE rpt_inventory_cost_daily SET projection_status=#{status},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND projection_version=#{targetProjectionVersion}
UPDATE rpt_projection_lineage SET projection_status=#{status},processed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND projection_version=#{projectionVersion} AND metric_family=#{family}
mapper.select: SELECT source_event_id sourceEventId,source_owner sourceOwner,source_aggregate_id sourceAggregateId, source_sequence sourceSequence,partition_key partitionKey,schema_version schemaVersion, projection_version projectionVersion,content_sha256 contentSha256,occurred_at occurredAt, business_date businessDate,org_id orgId,store_id storeId,terminal_id terminalId,cashier_id cashierId, warehouse_id warehouseId,sku_id skuId,currency,metric_family metricFamily,order_count orderCount, cancelled_order_count cancelledOrderCount,return_count returnCount,gross_minor grossMinor, discount_minor discountMinor,surcharge_minor surchargeMinor,receivable_minor receivableMinor, refund_minor refundMinor,cash_received_minor cashReceivedMinor,cash_refunded_minor cashRefundedMinor, shift_difference_minor shiftDifferenceMinor,promotion_snapshot_count promotionSnapshotCount, on_hand_delta onHandDelta,available_delta availableDelta,reserved_delta reservedDelta, ledger_quantity_delta ledgerQuantityDelta,purchase_quantity_delta purchaseQuantityDelta, stocktake_quantity_delta stocktakeQuantityDelta,transfer_quantity_delta transferQuantityDelta, inventory_value_delta_minor inventoryValueDeltaMinor,cogs_delta_minor cogsDeltaMinor, purchase_cost_delta_minor purchaseCostDeltaMinor,stocktake_cost_delta_minor stocktakeCostDeltaMinor, transfer_cost_delta_minor transferCostDeltaMinor,correlation_id correlationId FROM rpt_source_event_inbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='APPLIED' AND business_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ORDER BY business_date,source_owner,partition_key,source_sequence,source_event_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rpt_sales_daily WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND projection_version=#{projectionVersion} AND business_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}
DELETE FROM rpt_inventory_cost_daily WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND projection_version=#{projectionVersion} AND business_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}
DELETE FROM rpt_projection_lineage WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND projection_version=#{projectionVersion} AND business_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}
mapper.select: SELECT rebuild_id rebuildId,projection_version projectionVersion,from_date fromDate,to_date toDate,state, requested_by requestedBy,correlation_id correlationId,event_count eventCount, projection_digest projectionDigest,created_at createdAt FROM rpt_projection_rebuild WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rebuild_id=#{objectId}
mapper.update: UPDATE rpt_projection_rebuild SET state=#{state},event_count=#{eventCount},projection_digest=#{digest}, completed_at=#{completedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rebuild_id=#{rebuildId} AND state='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM rpt_export_request WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND export_id=#{objectId}
SELECT FROM rpt_export_artifact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND export_id=#{objectId}
mapper.update: UPDATE rpt_export_artifact SET download_token_sha256=#{tokenSha256},token_user_id=#{userId}, token_expires_at=#{tokenExpiresAt},downloaded_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND export_id=#{exportId} AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rpt_export_request e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.export_id=#{exportId} AND e.state='READY' AND e.version=#{expectedVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM rpt_difference WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY detected_at DESC,difference_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM rpt_difference WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND difference_id=#{objectId}
